parameters.name: Aggregator
parameters.description:
The aggregator. You can use one or more aggregators to query aggregated information about instances.
Valid values:

- ACS:Application.Name

- ACS:Application.Version

parameters.name: Filter
parameters.description: The filter rules for the component.

sub_parameters.name: Name
sub_parameters.description: The name of the component property. You can specify up to five filters. Property names vary for different components. Call the [GetInventorySchema](https://api.aliyun.com/#/?product=oos\&version=2019-06-01\&api=GetInventorySchema) operation to query the property names of different components. For example, the ACS:InstanceInformation component has the InstanceId property. For this component, set this parameter to ACS:InstanceInformation.InstanceId.

sub_parameters.name: Operator
sub_parameters.description:
The comparison operator for the property value. You can specify up to five filters.
Valid values:

- Equal

- NotEqual

- BeginWith

- LessThan

- GreaterThan

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: A list of values for the component property query.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 50.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The token that is used to retrieve the next page of results.
